name: TOLID
description: This study presents the Turkish Offensive Language Identification Dataset (TOLID), a large-scale, high-quality dataset for the automatic detection of offensive language in Turkish social media posts and evaluates the performance of several transformer-based models. Although most previous studies have been constrained by small sample sizes, imbalanced class distributions, or narrow topical focus, TOLID includes a wide range of offensive expressions without imposing restrictions on topics, individuals, or groups.
